# Synapse CLI Reference

# synapse - Synapse - CMN Federated Indexer

```text
Usage: synapse [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --config <CONFIG>
          Configuration file path

          [default: config.yml]

      --rebuild-search
          Rebuild the search vector index from storage, then exit. Requires the ruvector feature and a running embedding server (Ollama). Stop the running synapse process before using this flag

      --stdout-file <PATH>
          Redirect stdout to this file

      --stderr-file <PATH>
          Redirect stderr to this file

  -h, --help
          Print help. Add --output json|yaml|markdown to render this help in another format.

  -V, --version
          Print version
```
